nodes.name: Cargo.toml
nodes.summary: Rust workspace manifest defining the Stylo project's 11 member crates, their versioning at 0.18.0, and in-repo dependency paths for building all components together.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview documenting Stylo as a high-performance CSS style engine for Servo and Firefox, with sections on branches, crate architecture, local build setup, and release process.

nodes.name: SYNCING.md
nodes.summary: Step-by-step guide for syncing this repository with the upstream Stylo copy in mozilla-central, covering upstream filtering from mozilla-central and rebasing main onto the filtered upstream.

nodes.name: commit-from-merge.sh
nodes.summary: Shell utility that creates a git commit borrowing the author name, email, and date from a bors merge commit, used during the sync workflow to preserve attribution.

nodes.name: commit-from-squashed.sh
nodes.summary: Shell utility that creates a git commit reusing author, date, and message from a GitHub merge queue squashed commit, used during the sync workflow to preserve metadata.

nodes.name: start-rebase.sh
nodes.summary: Shell script that automates git rebase onto a new upstream base by finding the first downstream commit and using it as the old base for --onto rebasing.

nodes.name: style.paths
nodes.summary: git-filter-repo path filtering configuration that specifies which mozilla-central paths (servo/components/ and rustfmt.toml) to extract and how to rename them for this repository.

nodes.name: shell.nix
nodes.summary: Nix derivation providing a development shell environment named style-sync-shell, pinned to a specific nixpkgs revision for reproducible tooling during the sync process.
nodes.languageNotes: Pins nixpkgs to a specific commit SHA for deterministic shell environments.
